spans.text: The model was introduced by (and named for) Yann LeCun, then a researcher at AT&T Bell Labs, for the purpose of recognizing handwritten digits in images :cite:`LeCun.Bottou.Bengio.ea.1998`.
To this day, some ATMs still run the code that Yann LeCun and his colleague Leon Bottou wrote in the 1990s!
